paite: Hiaite anam minte uh ahi: Mallam gamgi Tuipi Lian a kipan a Hethlon paisuak in Hamath lutna phaizang ah Damaskas gamgi a Hamath kiang mallam pang Hazar-enan pha in, suahlam leh tumlam ah tan khat Dante tan ahi.
heading: Namte Lak A Gam Hawmna
english: “Now these are the names of the tribes: From the north end, beside the way of Hethlon to the entrance of Hamath, Hazar Enan at the border of Damascus, northward beside Hamath (and they shall have their sides east and west), Dan, one portion.

paite: Dante tan toh kigi in suahlam leh tumlam ah tan khat Asherte tan ahi.
english: “By the border of Dan, from the east side to the west side, Asher, one portion.

paite: Asherte tan toh kigi in suahlam leh tumlam ah tan khat Naphtalite tan ahi.
english: “By the border of Asher, from the east side even to the west side, Naphtali, one portion.

paite: Naphtalite tan toh kigi in suahlam leh tumlam ah tan khat Manassehte tan ahi.
english: “By the border of Naphtali, from the east side to the west side, Manasseh, one portion.

paite: Manassehte tan toh kigi in suahlam leh tumlam ah tan khat Ephraimte tan ahi.
english: “By the border of Manasseh, from the east side to the west side, Ephraim, one portion.

paite: Ephraimte tan toh kigi in suahlam leh tumlam ah tan khat Reubente tan ahi.
english: “By the border of Ephraim, from the east side even to the west side, Reuben, one portion.

paite: Reubente tan toh kigi in suahlam leh tumlam ah tan khat Judahte tan ahi.
english: “By the border of Reuben, from the east side to the west side, Judah, one portion.

paite: Judahte tan toh kigi in suahlam leh tumlam ah, thilpiak na lat ding uh avai tong singnih-le-sangnga ahi ding a; adung suahlam leh tumlam sang ah tan dang bangmah in ahi a, alai a mun siangthou om in.
heading: Gam Lai A Mun Poimohte
english: “By the border of Judah, from the east side to the west side, shall be the offering which you shall offer, twenty-five thousand reeds in width, and in length as one of the portions, from the east side to the west side; and the sanctuary shall be in the middle of it.

paite: Thilpiak TOUPA kiang a na lat ding uh adung tong singnih-le-sangnga, avai tong singnih ahi ding ahi.
english: “The offering that you shall offer to Yahweh shall be twenty-five thousand reeds in length, and ten thousand in width.

paite: Huan hiai ah siampute a ding in gam siangthou thilpiak ding ahi ding a; mallam ah adung tong singnih-le-sangnga leh tumlam ah avai tong singkhat leh suahlam ah avai tong singkhat, simlam ah adung tong singnih-le-sangnga ahi ding ahi. Alaizang ah TOUPA mun siangthou a-om ding hi.
english: For these, even for the priests, shall be the holy offering: toward the north twenty-five thousand in length, and toward the west ten thousand in width, and toward the east ten thousand in width, and toward the south twenty-five thousand in length; and the sanctuary of Yahweh shall be in the middle of it.

paite: Siampu siansaksa, Zadok tapate ka thu kem mite a ding ahi ding, amaute Israel suante avakmang lai ua Levi chite avakmang bang ua vakmangloute ahi uhi.
english: It shall be for the priests who are sanctified of the sons of Zadok, who have kept my instruction, who didn’t go astray when the children of Israel went astray, as the Levites went astray.

paite: Huan gam thilpiak pumpi a kipan amau a dia piak tuam, mun siangthoupen ahi ding; Levi chi tan toh akigi in.
english: It shall be to them an offering from the offering of the land, a most holy thing, by the border of the Levites.

paite: Siampu tan zulzul ah Levi chite'n tan anei ding ua, adung tong singnih-le-sangnga, avai tong singkhat ahi ding hi.
english: “Alongside the border of the priests, the Levites shall have twenty-five thousand cubits in length and ten thousand in width. All the length shall be twenty-five thousand, and the width ten thousand.

paite: Huan azuak ding uh ahi kei a, akhen ding uh leng ahi sam kei; agam hoihna tata leng midang kiang a piak ding ahi kei hi; TOUPA a dia siangthou ahi ngal a.
english: They shall sell none of it, nor exchange it, nor shall the first fruits of the land be alienated, for it is holy to Yahweh.

paite: Huan avai tong singnih-le-sangnga ban ah tong sangnga vantang tan, khopi dinna ding, tenna inn dingte leh khopuate a ding ahi ding; khopi bel alaizang a a-om ding ahi.
english: “The five thousand cubits that are left in the width, in front of the twenty-five thousand, shall be for common use, for the city, for dwelling and for pasture lands; and the city shall be in the middle of it.

paite: Huchi in ateh vialdan hichibang in ahi ding: Amallam pang tong sangli-le-zanga, asimlam pang tong sangli-le-zanga; asuahlam pang tong sangli-le-zanga, atumlam pang tong sangli-le-zanga.
english: These shall be its measurements: the north side four thousand and five hundred, and the south side four thousand and five hundred, and on the east side four thousand and five hundred, and the west side four thousand and five hundred.

paite: Akhopi in khopua anei ding a; mallam pang in tong zanih-le-sawmnga; simlam pang tong zanih-le-sawmnga, suahlam pang tong zanih-le-sawmnga, tumlam pang tong zanih-le-sawmnga ahi.
english: The city shall have pasture lands: toward the north two hundred fifty, and toward the south two hundred fifty, and toward the east two hundred fifty, and toward the west two hundred fifty.

paite: Adunglam val lai, thilpiak siangthou zul a pen suahlam ah tong singkhat, tumlam ah tong singkhat ahi ding; thilpiak siangthousa zulzul ahi ding hi; huai a thilpawtte khopi a nasem mite nek ding ahi ding.
english: The remainder of the length, alongside the holy offering, shall be ten thousand eastward and ten thousand westward; and it shall be alongside the holy offering. Its increase shall be for food to those who labor in the city.

paite: Huchi in khopi a nasemmi Israel nam tengteng a mite'n alei alet ding uhi.
english: Those who labor in the city, out of all the tribes of Israel, shall cultivate it.

paite: Thilpiak pumpi adung tong singnih-le-sangnga, avai tong singnih-le-sangnga ahi ding; thilpiak siangthousa, dung leh vai kikim khopi tan toh na lat ding uh ahi.
english: All the offering shall be a square of twenty-five thousand by twenty-five thousand. You shall offer it as a holy offering, with the possession of the city.

paite: Aval thilpiaksa siangthou leh khopi tan pang lang tuaktuak vaihawmpa tan ahi ding a, suahlam sang ah thilpiak tong singnih-le-sangnga ban, gamseh dangte zulzul vaihawmpa tan ahi ding; huchi in thilpiak siangthousa leh tempul mun siangthou bel alaizang ah a-om ding.
english: “The remainder shall be for the prince, on the one side and on the other of the holy offering and of the possession of the city; in front of the twenty-five thousand of the offering toward the east border, and westward in front of the twenty-five thousand toward the west border, alongside the portions, it shall be for the prince. The holy offering and the sanctuary of the house shall be in the middle of it.

paite: Huan Levi chi tan leh khopi tan vaihawmpa tante kikal ah a-om ding a; vaihawmpa tan Judah tan leh Benjamin tan toh akigi ding.
english: Moreover, from the possession of the Levites, and from the possession of the city, being in the middle of that which is the prince’s, between the border of Judah and the border of Benjamin, shall be for the prince.

paite: Huan nam omlaite tungthu ah, suahlam leh tumlam ah tan khat Benjaminte tan ahi ding.
english: “As for the rest of the tribes: from the east side to the west side, Benjamin, one portion.

paite: Benjaminte tan toh kigi in suah leh tumlam ah tan khat Simeonte tan ahi.
english: “By the border of Benjamin, from the east side to the west side, Simeon, one portion.

paite: Simeonte tan toh kigi in suah leh tumlam Issakarte tan ahi.
english: “By the border of Simeon, from the east side to the west side, Issachar, one portion.

paite: Issakarte tan toh kigi in suah leh tumlam tan khat Zebulunte tan ahi.
english: “By the border of Issachar, from the east side to the west side, Zebulun, one portion.

paite: Zebulunte tan toh kigi in suah leh tumlam tan khat Gadte tan ahi.
english: “By the border of Zebulun, from the east side to the west side, Gad, one portion.

paite: Gadte tan simlam pang gamgi Tarmar a kipan in Meribah-kadesh tuite tan in Aigupta lui zui in Tuipi Lian atung ding hi.
english: “By the border of Gad, at the south side southward, the border shall be even from Tamar to the waters of Meribath Kadesh, to the brook, to the great sea.

paite: Hiai Israel namte goutan ding a gam kihawmdan ding leh agam sehtuamte ahi uh chih Toupa PATHIAN thupawt ahi.
english: “This is the land which you shall divide by lot to the tribes of Israel for inheritance, and these are their several portions, says the Lord Yahweh.

paite: Huan hiaite khopi a kipan pawtnate ahi uh; mallam pang tong sangli-le-zanga ah kongpi thum;
heading: Jerusalem Kongpite
english: “These are the exits of the city: On the north side four thousand five hundred reeds by measure;

paite: khopi kongpite Israel nam min bang zel a sak ding ahi a; mallam kongpi thumte, Reuben kongpi khat, Judah kongpi khat, Levi kongpi khat;
english: and the gates of the city shall be named after the tribes of Israel, three gates northward: the gate of Reuben, one; the gate of Judah, one; the gate of Levi, one.

paite: suahlam pang tong sangli-le-zanga ah kongpi thum; Joseph kongpi khat, Benjamin kongpi khat, Dan kongpi khat ahi ding hi.
english: “At the east side four thousand five hundred reeds, and three gates: even the gate of Joseph, one; the gate of Benjamin, one; the gate of Dan, one.

paite: Simlam pang tong sangli-le-zanga ah kongpi thum; Simeon kongpi khat, Issakar kongpi khat, Zebulun kongpi khat ahi ding.
english: “At the south side four thousand five hundred reeds by measure, and three gates: the gate of Simeon, one; the gate of Issachar, one; the gate of Zebulun, one.

paite: Tumlam pang tong sangli-le-zanga ah kongpi thum; Gad kongpi khat, Asher kongpi khat, Naphtali kongpi khat ahi ding hi.
english: “At the west side four thousand five hundred reeds, with their three gates: the gate of Gad, one; the gate of Asher, one; the gate of Naphtali, one.

paite: Akimvel in tong singkhat-le-sanggiat ahi ding a; huai ni a kipan in khopi min bel, "TOUPA omna mun" chih ahi ding hi.
english: “It shall be eighteen thousand reeds in circumference; and the name of the city from that day shall be, ‘Yahweh is there.’
